heading.title: Relations of Partners to Third Parties

article.title: Effect of admissions by a partner.
article.content: An admission or representation made by a partner concerning the affairs of the firm is evidence against the firm, if it is made in the ordinary course of business.
article.html:
23Effect of admissions by a partner.

Section 23 · Chapter IV · page 7 of the Act

An admission or representation made by a partner concerning the affairs of the firm is evidence against the firm, if it is made in the ordinary course of business.
